Die Toten Hosen auf Tour - Weil du nur einmal lebst (2019) Blu-ray



The acclaimed tour documentation with lots of music now finally on DVD: the filmmakers Cordula Kablitz-Post and Paul Dugdale were on tour with the Dead Pants in 2018. The result is an intimate portrait of the band, but also the documentation about the madness of the tour: after many great concerts, the abrupt stop through the hearing fall of Campino in Berlin, the new beginning in Stuttgart, the trip to SO 36 and the grandiose conclusion at the stadium in Düsseldorf before it was still together to Argentina at the end of the year. .
Created from hundreds of hours of material in months of work, the film accompanies the band over the entire tour period before and behind the scenes and tells their story using many of their songs and in their own words. The director who has accompanied Die Toten Hosen seit zehn Jahren immer wieder mal filmisch zeigt die Jungs und ihre Crew während der Tour auf der Bühne, Backstage und im Tourbus. Unmade up and uncensored. She captured high and low points of an extraordinary year. For the concert recordings, the renowned music film director Paul Dugdale could be won, who has become known for his work with the Rolling Stones or Coldplay and produced the DVD "The Crash of the Republic" with the band already in 2014. . "We feel very well met in the film and had great pleasure watching the strip", Campino is delighted.
Because you only live once – the dead trousers on tour shows the phenomenon of "trousers", which the band may not be able to explain itself. The Dead Pants play on mega stages and deliver grandiose shows in small clubs. They offer intolerant political currents at the Chemnitzer #wirsindmehr concert against the right the forehead and show themselves sweaty and unmake-up. Authentic So if you wonder why the Dead Pants still exist today and why they are so successful, this film gives the answer: Honest lasts the longest. The trouser slicer also has nothing to do with it.
Exclusively on this Blu-ray there are 17 minutes of unreleased bonus material created during the filming of the film.
